title: The caudillo: a leader with his own army
goal: Read about the caudillos of the 19th century, and use relative clauses to say who they were and who followed them.
grammar: Relative clauses with que and quien

items: Use relative clauses with *que* and *quien* to say who a caudillo was and who followed him.
Say what a caudillo gave to the men who supported him.
Say who Juan Manuel de Rosas was and when he governed Buenos Aires.
Say why historians disagree about the caudillos.
Use the key words of this lesson: landowner, farm worker, follower, charisma, weak and loyal.
